description: Open Brain is a user-owned memory and continuity layer for coding agents. It stores provenance-aware semantic memory in PostgreSQL + pgvector, builds trusted context across sessions, and supports reviewed learning through REST, MCP, CLI, a dashboard, and adapters for Hermes, Medusa, Codex, and Claude Code.
